round: # Story 18: Sara and the apple (a girl tells it). Language up to unit 18.

say_en: Hello! My name is Sara. I am eight.
show_en: Hello! My name is Sara. I am eight.

say_en: This is my bag. It is green.
show_en: This is my bag. It is green.

wrong_say_fa: این رنگ نیست. بکس سارا سبز است. دوباره انتخاب کن.

say_en: Look! This is an apple. It is big and red.
show_en: Look! This is an apple. It is big and red.

say_en: This is my friend, Laila. She is sad.
show_en: This is my friend, Laila. She is sad.

say_en: Laila is sad. Give Laila the apple.
wrong_say_fa: این سیب نیست. سارا می‌خواهد سیب را به لیلا بدهد. دوباره انتخاب کن.

say_en: Here you are, Laila. Thank you, Sara!
show_en: Here you are, Laila. Thank you, Sara!

say_en: Laila is happy. I am happy. Goodbye!
show_en: Laila is happy. I am happy. Goodbye!

say_en: m: This is my classroom. This is the door. This is the board.
